# PR — 298_R6FIX.31 (BL-115: durable outbox for the delayed arms)

## Summary

- Closes the mark-then-send hole on the three delayed arms per the 2026-11-16 operator ruling
  (outbox pattern): `account.hard-delete`, `project.purge`, `account.export` previously committed
  their durable marker on the app DB and sent the pg-boss job on the system DSN — a crash between
  them could strand an armed intent until the hourly watchdog repaired it.
- Migration `0064` adds a system-scoped `outbox` table (workspace-keyed, not RLS'd, `pause_signals`
  posture; `grant insert` only — the slo_samples grant class). Each arm now writes marker + intent
  in ONE `txRunner` tenant tx.
- New `outbox.drain` worker cron replays pending rows onto pg-boss with `payload` and `send_options`
  verbatim (`startAfterMs`/`singletonKey` travel with the intent): SKIP-LOCKED claim, 60 s lease,
  25-attempt bound, `sent_at` only post-send, bounded `last_error`.
- Existing hourly watchdogs stay as the belt; request paths no longer call `queue.send` at all —
  the `.catch(() => undefined)` failure mode is structurally gone.
